status: PREREGISTERED AND PREPARED, NOT AUTHORIZED TO FLY. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-09-e21-draft-then-refresh-dr1-v1-preregistration.md. Owner Decision 13-J of 2026-09-09 asked for the family and authorized the MODEL-FREE preparation only; the three flight rows do not exist and must be registered, with consumed = no, before the first contact. The serving geometry named below is a PROJECTION: the prompt fit in SERVER mode (scripts/e21_dr1_prompt_fit.py, run id SAEA-E21-DR1-PROMPT-FIT-V1) certifies or replaces it before the first flight contact, under the same pre-fixed lever order KC-E1f's fit used.
purpose: DRAFT THEN REFRESH. The Observe stage uses the SHORT speech to draft quickly and the Plan stage hands the model the LONG speech together with that draft, once. Pass 1 is the sealed SAEA-E21-OBS-E1-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V1 -- 5,122 speaker-turn units over the same 44 calls, NOT re-flown -- stitched onto the sealed comparator's 1,593 fixed 90-second windows by saea-e21-unit-draft-majority-overlap-v1 and bound content-free, exactly as KC-E1f bound the comparator's own windows. Pass 2 gives each window its whole 90 seconds of audio plus that window's stitched unit-draft as typed content and asks for the window's final transcript: ONE contact per window, 1,593 per arm. The family exists because OBS-E1 bought +1.0487 points of corpus WER and sold 2.0912 points of ConEC-mirror PERSON entity WER, and the model-free decomposition located 78.7 % of that harm in units under ten seconds and named the failure a CONDITIONING failure rather than a truncation one. DR-1 is the second of the two ways to give a short unit back its context: OBS-E1b gives it more AUDIO, DR-1 gives the long window the short unit's TEXT.

population.selection: no draw: the whole frozen earnings21-original discovery split -- the same 44 calls, the same 1,593 fixed 90-second windows and the same split identity the sealed comparator, KC-E1, KC-E1f and OBS-E1 all flew. The E5 split (34 kb-construction, 10 r4-e21-sub10 evaluation) is a REPORTING split; the ten carry 342 paired windows, below the program's n >= 400 rule, and are reported apart and descriptively with no interval quoted.
population.estimand: corpus WER and per-entity-class ConEC-mirror entity WER, pooled over the reported roster, paired at the 90-second window and clustered at the call against the sealed comparator, against OBS-E1 and against KC-E1f.

unit_draft.why_it_is_not_reflown: OBS-E1 already decoded every one of these units, and its bytes ARE the draft. Re-flying pass 1 would double the contacts, spend a second 1.07 GPU-h, and -- because greedy decoding on llama-server is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions -- would produce a draft that is NOT the arm the family is read against.

self_draft.why_it_is_the_twin: the DR-1s draft is the comparator's own sealed hypothesis for the same window: a long-window draft refreshed with the same long window. It isolates the draft's SOURCE, which is the only thing DR-1c claims.

secondary_comparators.SAEA-E21-OBS-E1-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V1: corpus WER 7.15078, PERSON 24.58005. Does the refresh recover the names the units lost? REJECTED under its own rule and quoted as a comparator, never as an admitted effect.
secondary_comparators.SAEA-E21-KC-E1F-REPAIR-44-V1: corpus WER 8.1545, PERSON 18.752. Is a knowledge-free refresh competitive with the brief repair? ADMITTED provisionally with its replication UNMET, so it is quoted as a comparator and this family cannot discharge its replication.

comparator.pairing_rule: the fixed 90-second window is the paired unit (1,593), the call is the bootstrap cluster (44), the estimator is the pooled ratio through analysis.paired.resampled_statistic with cluster_of=analysis.e21_window_pairing.call_of, seed 20260903, 10,000 replicates, CI90, both weightings.

cells.delivery: e21-entity-repair-substitutions-v1 at KC-E1f's own committed parameters (4 / 0.60 / 0.10)
cells.obs: fixed 90-second windows, no VAD trim, no overlap, no rolling tail, no preprocessing -- byte-identical to the comparator's, KC-E1's and KC-E1f's OBS protocol, and enforced fail-closed by the policy.
cells.serving_geometry: -c 36864 -np 6, 6,144 tokens per slot, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU. PROJECTED; the prompt fit decides.
cells.audio_path: raw audio through the bf16 mmproj on the GPU; no feature cache

cells.delivery: e21-free-refresh-delivery-v1 -- the response verbatim, with only the two whole-response refusals the constrained rule shares

one_factor.dr1c_vs_dr1f: the DELIVERY RULE, and nothing else. The two baseline fragments carry the identical key set and differ in exactly two values: response_postprocessor and response_postprocessor_params. Same draft, same frame, same instruction, same audio, same decoding parameters, same scorers, same OBS protocol.
one_factor.dr1c_vs_dr1s: the DRAFT's SOURCE. The two fragments differ in exactly one key, predecessor_snapshot. The frame's wording is neutral about where the draft came from precisely so that the twin does not also change what the model was told.
one_factor.against_the_sealed_comparator: TWO things move and this document says so rather than hiding it: a second contact per window exists at all, and that contact carries a draft. The comparator contrast is therefore reported as refresh-pass-plus-draft; the SOURCE attribution comes from the DR-1s twin, which pays the identical contact.
one_factor.against_obs_e1: the transport unit is given back the long window. OBS-E1 delivered 5,122 short units and stitched their text; DR-1 delivers 1,593 long windows and shows them that same text. Reported as a cross-cell reading, never as this family's decision.
one_factor.against_kc_e1f: the knowledge. KC-E1f's second pass carried the cap-12 ConEC brief and an entity-repair instruction over the comparator's own draft; DR-1s carries no evidence at all over the same draft. Reported as a cross-cell reading.

shared_protocol.prompt_order: evidence-first-system-v3 (from the model fragment). There is no evidence block: the draft rides at the END of the rendered task_instruction inside the frozen frame e21-draft-refresh-frame-v1, exactly where reproduction.obs_loop's own OBS_TAIL_FRAME_V1 conditioned tail rides. It is model output, framed as model output, never a reference transcript, and it lands verbatim in the sealed MODEL_REQUEST record.
shared_protocol.payload_fields: the D2-frozen bare-core field set, unchanged. No new key reaches the wire.
shared_protocol.contacts_per_item: ONE per 90-second window; 1,593 windows over 44 calls per cell. Pass 1 is read, not flown.
shared_protocol.harness: core.driver.run_experiment_bundled through the same committed launcher path the comparator, KC-E1 and KC-E1f flew; the registered core.base policy obs-repair-loop is ObsAgentLoopPolicy with ONE method overridden.

evaluation.paper_facing_metric: corpus WER is the primary here, with ConEC-mirror PERSON entity WER as the non-inferiority half; the family exists to keep OBS-E1's corpus-WER gain without its PERSON loss
mandatory_slices: per entity class, with reference-word counts, beside the comparator's, OBS-E1's and KC-E1f's own per-class tables
all 44, the construction 34 and the evaluation 10, reported apart

the delivery ledger: windows refused by reason, windows changed, accepted substitutions, substituted tokens, and rejected opcodes by class -- all four classes reported even at zero, for BOTH delivery rules, so the two arms' edit profiles sit in one table

the delivered-vs-comparator operation table: substitutions, deletions and insertions against the comparator's 13,098 / 5,701 / 10,700. DR-1c is substitution-only in RAW whitespace-token space by construction and every normalized move must be attributed to a substituted span; DR-1f is NOT, and its deletion and insertion counts are the measurement
the draft length distributions of the unit-draft and the self-draft arms, in whitespace tokens and in flight tokens, so the twin's token match is reported as a measurement and never asserted
by sector (9 levels) and sample rate (5 levels), natural mixture and equal-stratum weighting

the OBS-E1 harm strata, re-read on the delivered text: unit duration class, distance to the nearest unit boundary, and end-cut kind, so the family says WHETHER the refresh reached the stratum that carried the 61 excess PERSON errors

core-pressure covariates: contacts per window and per call, prompt and completion tokens against the comparator's 1,935,965 / 439,532 and KC-E1f's 3,550,695 / 434,219, delivered audio seconds, and the share of the final transcript the control plane delivered unchanged

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,593 windows + 157 of retry headroom = 1,750 per cell, x 3 cells = 5,250. The comparator, KC-E1, KC-E1f and the null replicate each realized exactly 1,593 for one pass at this tiling.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 141,348.532 realized per pass, rounded up to 150,000 with retry headroom, x 3 cells = 450,000. The tiling is the comparator's and pass 1 is not re-flown, so the audio per pass is the comparator's own.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: KC-E1f realized 1.1093 GPU-h by the manifest's own nvidia-smi sampler for one pass of 1,593 windows at this tiling, with a cap-12 brief in the prompt that DR-1 does not carry; the projection is therefore 1.1093 per cell and 3.33 for the family, registered at 1.2 per cell and 3.6 for headroom -- KC-E1f's own registered per-cell figure. Re-measured on the preflight; a flight STOPS and reports if the measured rate projects past its own cell ceiling.
execution_plan_basis.budget_is_run_cumulative: core/model/adapter.py enforces planned_model_calls and planned_speech_audio_seconds across ALL attempts of a run id; a successor plan must cover prior durable spend plus its own worst case.

decision.order: DR-1c, then DR-1f, then DR-1s. One experiment in flight; the order is fixed here so it cannot be chosen after a number exists.
decision.primary: corpus WER on the reported roster: ADMITTED as an observe-plus-refresh module if the call-clustered CI90 lower bound on the reduction (comparator - cell) is > 0 AND ConEC-mirror PERSON entity WER is non-inferior to the comparator at this carrier's own margin, LB(cell - comparator) >= -0.25009. ADMITTED AS AN IMPROVEMENT if PERSON also improves with LB > 0.
guards: delivery integrity (DR-1c and DR-1s only): every window's delivered text equals its bound draft outside the accepted substitution spans and carries the identical whitespace-token count -- a construction check that ABORTS the read
window coverage: every one of the 1,593 windows is delivered exactly once -- a construction check that ABORTS the read
corpus WER is the primary here and is not also a guard
over-generation, insertions per reference word: UB(cell - comparator) <= +0.02218
